_comment: Traduction fr → en des libellés du questionnaire MunaGo. Le rejeu reçoit le lot [{path, text}] réellement envoyé et renvoie les MÊMES `path` : la table ci-dessous est indexée par le texte source (espaces normalisés, casse ignorée). Un texte absent de la table est recopié tel quel, exactement comme le ferait un modèle sur un texte déjà en anglais. Traductions rédigées à la main — résultat SIMULÉ.

by_text.WhatsApp / appel à l'enfant: WhatsApp or a call to the child
by_text.Peur de casser / perdre: Fear of breaking or losing it
by_text.Chez la nounou / le chauffeur: With the nanny or the driver
by_text.Ne sait pas / refuse de chiffrer: Doesn't know / won't give a figure
by_text.Option A — appareil 20 000 FCFA + 3 000: Option A — device 20,000 FCFA + 3,000 FCFA / month, no long commitment
by_text.Option B — appareil 5 000 FCFA + 6 000 F: Option B — device 5,000 FCFA + 6,000 FCFA / month, 12-month commitment
by_text.6 mois d'avance avec une petite réductio: 6 months in advance with a small discount
by_text.Non, si c'est pour sa sécurité: No, not if it keeps them safe
by_text.Ça m'inquiète (et si elle disparaît / ar: It worries me (what if it disappears / a scam)
by_text.Indifférent — je juge le produit: Doesn't matter — I judge the product
by_text.Je préférerais une marque étrangère conn: I'd rather have a well-known foreign brand
by_text.P1. Nombre d'enfants scolarisés de 3 à 1: P1. Number of children aged 3 to 18 in school
by_text.P3. Quel moyen de transport les enfants: P3. How do the children mainly travel to their place of study? (Consider only children aged 3 to 18)
by_text.D. Situation actuelle — le problème tel: D. Current situation — the problem as they live it
by_text.Ne pas suggérer « GPS », « traceur », «: Do not suggest "GPS", "tracker" or "kidnapping". Let them find their own words. If there was no incident, write that down explicitly — it is a result.
by_text.D1. Quand vos enfants ne sont pas avec v: D1. When your children are not with you and you have no idea where they are (school, on the road, at a relative's), what do you actually do to find out where they are?
by_text.D2. Vous est-il déjà arrivé de ne pas sa: D2. Has it ever happened that you did not know exactly where one of your children was?
by_text.D3. Pourriez-vous relater la dernière oc: D3. Could you tell us about the last time you did not know where one of your children was? What happened next?
by_text.D4 mesure si 4 000 FCFA/mois est de l'ar: D4 measures whether 4,000 FCFA/month is "invisible" money or a real trade-off. Write down the silence if there is one.
by_text.D4. Si vous deviez ajouter 4 000 FCFA pa: D4. If you had to add 4,000 FCFA a month to your budget, would that be a significant increase? (exact words, note any silence)
by_text.E. Présentation du concept — à lire tel: E. Presenting the concept — read it as written
by_text.Montrer l'appareil. Ne pas ajouter d'arg: Show the device. Do not add arguments ("it's against kidnappers", "it works even without network", and so on). After reading: silence. Wait for the first reaction.
by_text.« Il s'agit d'un petit appareil que l'en: "This is a small device that the child puts in their school bag. It lets you see where your child is from your phone, and alerts you if they leave an area you have defined. You can also call the device. The device costs about 20,000 FCFA to buy, and then there is a monthly subscription for the service."
by_text.5. Qu'est-ce que vous en pensez ? (Premi: 5. What do you think of it? (First reaction, word for word)
by_text.Cote enquêteur après coup, sans influenc: Rated by the interviewer afterwards, without influencing the answer
by_text.Laisser un silence. Ne pas répondre à l': Leave a silence. Do not answer the objection. Prompt only once: "Anything else?"
by_text.6. Qu'est-ce qui vous empêcherait d'util: 6. What would stop you from using this solution?
by_text.Cocher ensuite les thèmes (plusieurs pos: Then tick the themes (several possible), without saying so out loud
by_text.7. Pensez-vous que cet enfant porterait: 7. Do you think this child would carry the GPS tracker every day?
by_text.7. Dans quelles circonstances pourrait-i: 7. In what circumstances might they not carry it?
by_text.7b. Concrètement, où choisiriez-vous de: 7b. In practice, where would you choose to put it?
by_text.On cherche le point où ça casse, pas un: We are looking for the breaking point, not a theoretical "fair price". If the person negotiates, write the negotiation down; do not grant any discount.
by_text.F1. À 20 000 FCFA pour l'appareil seulem: F1. At 20,000 FCFA for the device alone, you would say:
by_text.F2. À partir de quel prix d'appareil dir: F2. At what device price would you clearly say: "No, it's not worth it"?
by_text.Indiquer un prix d'appareil d'au moins 1: Enter a device price of at least 1,000 FCFA.
by_text.F3. Pour un seul abonnement, à partir de: F3. For a single subscription, at what monthly amount would you decide to say no, even if you find the solution interesting?
by_text.10. Deux options. Laquelle choisiriez-vo: 10. Two options. Which one would you choose — if you had to pick one?
by_text.G. Paiement récurrent — mécanique réelle: G. Recurring payment — how it would really work
by_text.10. Quel moyen de règlement vous convien: 10. Which payment method would suit you best?
by_text.11. Si vous aviez le choix, vous préfére: 11. If you had the choice, you would prefer:
by_text.11b. Par quel canal de communication pré: 11b. Through which channel would you prefer to receive a payment reminder?
by_text.12. Est-ce que ça vous dérange qu'une so: 12. Does it bother you that a company would know your child's location at all times?
by_text.12. Qu'est-ce qu'il faudrait pour que vo: 12. What would it take for you to feel comfortable? (exact words)
by_text.12b. Cette société est camerounaise, enc: 12b. This company is Cameroonian and still little known. Does that change anything?
by_text.12c. Connaissez-vous déjà un objet ou un: 12c. Do you already know of a device or an app that does roughly this?
by_text.Familles urbaines · Douala · entretien f: Urban families · Douala · 12–15 min face-to-face interview + deposit test. To decide whether the MunaGo project is worth pursuing: only actions that cost something count.
by_text.Au moins 3 quartiers distincts par ville: At least 3 distinct neighbourhoods per city covered
by_text.Maximum 5 personnes du même réseau: At most 5 people from the same network
by_text.% activé à J+14 parmi les appareils reti: % activated at D+14 among devices collected
by_text.Au moins un enfant en école privée (hors: At least one child in private school (excluding public nursery or free neighbourhood school)
by_text.OUI verbal seulement (« je n'ai pas MoMo: Verbal YES only ("I don't have MoMo / I'll pay tonight") → count as NO, record the excuse
by_text.Hésite longtemps puis oui + paiement: Hesitates at length, then yes + payment
by_text.Pas l'argent maintenant: Doesn't have the money right now
by_text.Doit en parler au conjoint: Needs to discuss it with their partner
by_text.Méfiance acompte / arnaque: Distrust of the deposit / fear of a scam
by_text.A ouvert MoMo / cherché l'argent: Opened MoMo / looked for the money
by_text.A sorti le téléphone puis a reculé: Took out their phone, then backed off
by_text.A regardé le conjoint / un tiers: Looked at their partner or a third party
by_text.Une personne = une fiche. Toujours le mê: One person = one record. Always use the same code on the record, the MoMo receipt and the tracking sheet.
by_text.À relire chaque matin. Présenter le conc: Read again every morning. Present the concept as written, show the device, then stay silent. Record open answers word for word: no summarising. Never persuade, never correct an objection, never invent a promotion. Do not recruit more than 5 people from the same network. Check the screening questions before sitting down.
by_text.Mix volontaire : ne pas tout prendre dan: Deliberate mix: do not take everyone from Makepe or Logpom.
by_text.Lieu (repère précis du point d'enquête): Location (precise landmark of the survey point)
by_text.Réseau d'origine (nom du relais, sinon «: Referral network (name of the contact, otherwise "direct")
by_text.Maximum 5 personnes du même réseau / mêm: At most 5 people from the same network, church, school or extended family.
by_text.B. Introduction — 90 secondes. Si KO, on: B. Introduction — 90 seconds. If it fails, stop there.
by_text.« Bonjour Madame, Monsieur, je me présen: "Good morning, my name is [First name Last name], representing Honowa Tech. We are currently running a survey on child safety in urban areas as part of the MunaGo project. MunaGo is a subscription service offering a GPS tracker for families living in the city. This interview will take about fifteen minutes. Would you agree to take part?"
by_text.Acceptez-vous de participer ?: Do you agree to take part?
by_text.La personne refuse de participer. Remerc: The person declines to take part. Thank them and leave, without insisting.
by_text.B2. Avez-vous déjà été contacté au sujet: B2. Have you already been contacted about the MunaGo project?
by_text.Famille déjà vue au pilote ou déjà conta: Family already seen during the pilot or already contacted on WhatsApp about MunaGo. Thank them and leave.
by_text.F1. Avez-vous au moins un enfant de 3 à: F1. Do you have at least one child aged 3 to 18 in school?
by_text.Hors cible — pas d'enfant scolarisé: Out of scope — no child in school
by_text.Aucun enfant de 3 à 18 ans scolarisé : n: No child aged 3 to 18 in school: record the reason, thank them and leave.
by_text.F2. Parmi ces situations, laquelle est v: F2. Which of these situations applies to your household? (At least one required)
by_text.Hors cible — aucun signal de capacité: Out of scope — no capacity signal
by_text.Aucun des signaux de capacité : noter le: None of the capacity signals: record the reason and thank them.
by_text.P3. Quel moyen de transport les enfants: P3. How do the children mainly travel to their place of study? Consider only children aged 3 to 18.
by_text.Précisez le moyen de transport à l'aller: Specify the means of transport on the way there
by_text.Précisez le moyen de transport au retour: Specify the means of transport on the way back
by_text.D. Situation actuelle — le problème tel: D. Current situation — the problem as they live it (3 minutes)
by_text.Mot pour mot. Écrire ce qu'elle a dit, p: Word for word. Write down what they said, not a summary.
by_text.Récit mot pour mot. Ne pas relancer plus: Account word for word. Do not prompt more than once.
by_text.Cette question mesure si 4 000 FCFA/mois: This question measures whether 4,000 FCFA/month is "invisible" money or a real trade-off. Write down the silence if there is one.
by_text.Montrer l'appareil. Ne pas ajouter d'arg: Show the device. Do not add arguments ("it's against kidnappers", "it works even without network"). After reading: silence. Wait for the first reaction.
by_text.Écrire la phrase telle qu'elle est dite,: Write the sentence exactly as spoken, then rate it afterwards without influencing the answer.
by_text.Cote enquêteur après coup (ne pas lire): Interviewer rating, afterwards (do not read out)
by_text.Cocher ensuite les thèmes, sans le dire: Then tick the themes, without saying so out loud
by_text.F. Prix — appareil et abonnement (3 minu: F. Price — device and subscription (3 minutes)
by_text.Précisez l'autre option proposée par la: Specify the alternative option the person suggested
by_text.Test d'engagement — la seule question qu: Commitment test — the only question that really matters
by_text.C'est ici que se joue la valeur de l'enq: This is where the value of the survey is decided. One single offer, no alternative. Then silence.
by_text.Une seule proposition. Pas d'alternative: One single offer. No alternative ("we can deliver", "you can pay tomorrow", "I'll come back on Saturday"). Then silence. Offer the deposit once and accept a no.
by_text.« Nous allons mettre les premiers appare: "We are about to make the first devices available. If you want to reserve one, you pay 5,000 FCFA now by Mobile Money. It is refundable at any time and is deducted from the price of the device. You would collect it at [COLLECTION POINT] within 7 days. Would you like to reserve one?"
by_text.Quartier du point / temps de trajet esti: Neighbourhood of the collection point / travel time estimated by the person (minutes)
by_text.13. Prétexte du oui verbal (mots exacts): 13. Excuse given for the verbal yes (exact words)
by_text.L'acompte annoncé est de 5 000 FCFA ; en: The announced deposit is 5,000 FCFA; below 1,000 FCFA it is not a deposit.
by_text.N° WhatsApp (si acompte): WhatsApp number (if a deposit was paid)
by_text.Jour J + 7 : le rappeler à voix haute et: Day + 7: say it out loud and write it on the slip you hand over.
by_text.Photo du reçu MoMo + code fiche: Photo of the MoMo receipt with the record code
by_text.Mots exacts. Relance unique autorisée :: Exact words. One prompt allowed: "Is that the main reason, or is there something else?"
by_text.Thème principal du refus (cocher un seul: Main reason for refusal (tick one only)
by_text.La personne veut l'appareil sans verser: Does the person want the device without paying a deposit?
by_text.Noter le souhait, ne pas céder — cela vi: Record the request, do not give in — it would void the test.
by_text.Le « oui » verbal avant l'acompte était: The verbal "yes" before the deposit was:
by_text.UN seul message WhatsApp, texte fixe. Pa: ONE WhatsApp message only, fixed wording. No call, no second message, no "when are you coming?".
by_text.« Bonjour, rappel : votre appareil MunaG: "Hello, a reminder: your MunaGo device can be collected at ${point_retrait} before ${date_limite_retrait}. Kind regards."
by_text.Clôturer : retiré O/N. Si non : motif év: Close the case: collected Y/N. If not, record any reason they volunteer. Refund according to the agreed rule, with no sales discussion.
by_text.Motif si pas de retrait (mots de la pers: Reason if not collected (the person's own words, otherwise "silence")
by_text.Une question WhatsApp unique : « L'appar: One single WhatsApp question: "Is the device in use today?" Record Y/N and the verbatim if there is one.
by_text.Verbatim s'il y en a un (motif si pas d': Verbatim if there is one (reason if not activated, the person's own words, otherwise "silence")
